requirements.rule: Functional seniority allowance at 17, 27 and 32 years: the tabular annual rate is divided by 12 and also affects the thirteenth monthly payment. The standard rank rows are modelled; commissioners require the promoted_from_lower_rank worker role. Entitlement depends on qualifying service without demerit.
requirements.remediation: Validate disciplinary assessments over the two years preceding each threshold (D.P.R. 254/1999 art. 5(3)); distinguish eligible service from raw seniority, model special coordinator and intermediate ranks including D.P.R. 57/2022 art. 5 increments and four-year designation conditions, and determine commissioner origin. The sources do not state the allowance installment divisor; annual/12 plus a thirteenth is an explicitly stated convention inferred from the stipend table and D.L. 387/1987 art. 6(4)-(5).

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2). A national CCNL rule that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails (art. 32 c. 1-bis), and the bundle holds none; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event. Same-day cumulation with the other permits and rests of the decree, which the criterion excludes, is not checked.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Accordo triennio 2025-2027 (Comparto Sicurezza-Difesa) firmato 2026-07-15 a Palazzo Vidoni. Tre nuovi valori del punto parametrale: 200,90 EUR/anno (decorrenza 2025-01-01), 205,40 EUR/anno (2026-01-01), 207,51 EUR/anno (2027-01-01), da T3=195,50. Incremento totale +12,01 punti pari al +6,14%. Retroattività 2025 e 2026 in forma di arretrati. DPR di recepimento (art. 2 D.Lgs. 195/1995) non ancora emanato al 2026-09-09; firma definitiva sospesa per il nodo della previdenza dedicata. I nuovi periodi non sono modellati in attesa del DPR. Fonte: UIL Polizia (uilpolizia.com), money.it.
requirements.remediation: Add the punto parametrale 200.90 / 205.40 / 207.51 periods when the DPR is issued, then remove this limitation.

requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded. A CCNL whose comporto the engine counts over the calendar year (Commercio Art. 186 and the others with comporto_calendar_year) is not affected.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.
